description: T-3666: Excel's date names under every LCID that has a locale (probes/t3666-lcid-locale-map), one row per LCID. Each cell joins with CHAR(31): the LCID, mmm and mmmm of the 12 months of 2023, ddd and dddd of 2023-01-01 (a Sunday) to 01-07, AM/PM of 0.25 and 0.75, A/P of 0.75, yyyy-mm-dd and d mmmm of 45000.
